# Bundled Open-Source Fonts

These fonts are used by `scripts/add_subtitle.py` to burn HEADLINE banners
and CAPTIONS into b2b-video-factory output videos. Bundling them here means
the skill works on any machine without depending on system fonts (and avoids
any commercial-font licensing concerns).

| File | Use | License | Source |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ArchivoBlack-Regular.ttf` | HEADLINE pill (top banner) | SIL Open Font License 1.1 | https://github.com/Omnibus-Type/ArchivoBlack |
| `Roboto-Black.ttf` | CAPTIONS (default — heaviest weight for TikTok karaoke style) | Apache License 2.0 | https://github.com/googlefonts/roboto-2 |
| `Roboto-Bold.ttf` | CAPTIONS (alt — slightly lighter) | Apache License 2.0 | https://github.com/googlefonts/roboto-2 |
| `Roboto-Regular.ttf` | reserved | Apache License 2.0 | https://github.com/googlefonts/roboto-2 |

Both licenses permit free commercial use, embedding, and redistribution.
